Sessions Delivered

  • Introduction to CS Fundamentals (Hardware)

    2026

    • Instructor
    • OLIVESOFT
    • Slides (.pptx)

    Delivered a two-part technical workshop for the OLIVE-LEARN program at OLIVESOFT:

    • Part 1 — Efficient Code Execution & Hardware Architectures: modern computing architectures, CPU instruction pipelining, memory hierarchies & caching, DMA, NIC, and APU interactions.
    • Part 2 — Circuit-Level Computation & Storage: designed foundational computing units from basic SR & D latches up to a 4-bit register, 1-bit / 4-bit adders, and an Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU).
